Responsibility: Own the constitutional rules (P/I/G/EC) the ADR series the baseline index and the final vocabulary. Rules enter and leave the constitution only through this domain.
Scope: ADR-002; ADR-001; ADR index; baseline v2 index; glossary/vocabulary; document-transition-matrix
EnforcementObjective: The constitution is complete versioned and change-controlled; every rule is registered with a legal state.

Responsibility: Derive a falsifiable operational predicate for every rule; own the Constraint Registry. A rule with no constraint is not a rule.
ConstitutionalAuthority: Enterprise Architecture (ADR board); Domain Architecture for domain-model-derived constraints
EnforcementObjective: Every rule has exactly one checkable constraint.

Responsibility: Define and curate the artifacts constraints examine; record the ownership of each artifact (P2 I4 G5); own the Evidence Registry.
Scope: Aggregate model; business dependency graph; natural-key sets; construction product; dead-data inventory; documents; database state
ConstitutionalAuthority: Single ownership per artifact (P2 G5): Domain Architecture (models); Engineering Governance (engineering artifacts); DevOps Governance (operational artifacts); Enterprise Architecture (constitutional documents)
EnforcementObjective: Every constraint has a defined owned current evidence source.

Responsibility: Define and execute objective procedures evaluating evidence against constraints; record results. Independent of implementers.
Scope: EC1-EC10 as the initial verification set; thereafter one procedure per constraint
EnforcementObjective: Verification is objective repeatable binary and its results are recorded as Decisions.

Responsibility: Define the binding process points where verification results are enforced.
Scope: Document publication; document disposition; ADR approval; construction acceptance; cutover
ConstitutionalAuthority: Engineering Governance (engineering gates); Enterprise Architecture (constitutional gates); DevOps Governance (cutover)
EnforcementObjective: No action passes a gate while a required verification has failed or is unexecuted.

Responsibility: Record every verification outcome gate ruling ADR approval and sanctioned exception; own the Exception Registry. Exceptions are explicit bounded and expiring - never silent.
Scope: All decisions about constitutional objects; all exceptions (including the I11 SECURITY DEFINER precedent)
ConstitutionalAuthority: Enterprise Architecture (ADR board) for constitutional decisions; Independent Review Board for verification rulings
EnforcementObjective: Every enforcement outcome is recorded with authority; no deviation exists without a recorded exception.

Responsibility: Own the rule state machine; assign and maintain the legal state of every constitutional object; detect state violations.
Scope: All constitutional objects (rules constraints evidence ADRs decisions exceptions gates)
EnforcementObjective: The current legal status of every constitutional object is known and observable.

Responsibility: Record construction and execution events with provenance that survives restore (I2 C3 P7); own the Execution Registry.
Scope: Dataset construction; migrations; Installer History; restore events
ConstitutionalAuthority: Engineering Governance / DevOps Governance (single ownership per execution artifact)
EnforcementObjective: Execution evidence survives restore; no decision relies on provenance-less execution state.
